Explicit authored analytic prerequisite restatement:
Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; W is C1 and exp(-W) is genuinely integrable. mu is exactly the normalized volume.tilted(-W) Gibbs probability, whose density is positive. No curvature or spectral gap is assumed.
Fix SAME original weighted-L2 real partial-linear gradient D with exact compact-C-infinity genuine gradient graph and closability before ALL u in D.closure.domain. Each queried u satisfies D.closure u=0 as an actual vector L2 class, not a pointwise derivative assertion or final kernel certificate.
For the SAME original Gibbs compact-gradient closure, EVERY domain element u with D.closure u=0 is weighted-AE ONE real constant. This is only one direction; constant-domain membership and full kernel equality are not asserted.
Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0 and actual full-space volume. Genuine locally-volume-L1 u, all C1 compact directional tests with legal integrable products and zero weak derivative imply ONE real constant volume-AE. Actual normalized Gibbs W C1/exp(-W) integrable, SAME original exact compact-smooth graph D and closability give closed-gradient-zero implies weighted-AE constant. Actual PBPS common Gaussian J/R/S and original dense D_y precede ALL closure-domain u; source C2 curvature/eta cap/positive partitions retained but no additional curvature is needed by the generic kernel leaf. Only one direction; constants-domain converse, full kernel equality, centered residual/epsilon0/range/Poincare/BL/core and both main/composition remain open. No global-volume integrability of constants, classical differentiability of rough u, Nontrivial E, final kernel certificate, spectral gap or joint fiber selector. TV never transfers unbounded cost.

blind_reconstruction.text:
Let E be the full finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel space with its canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero and all approved ambient instances. Let W:E->R be C1 and assume exp(-W) is integrable against volume. Define mu=volume.tilted(x->-W(x)), the actual normalized Gibbs measure exp(-W)/integral exp(-W) times volume. In this full-space setting the approved context gives the positive normalized density; no separate positive-partition hypothesis is a displayed binder in this statement.
For every real-linear partial operator D:L2(mu;R)->L2(mu;E), assume D is closable and its graph is characterized exactly as follows: for every scalar L2 class a and vector L2 class H, (a,H) belongs to D.graph iff there exists a smooth compactly supported real function phi:E->R with a=phi mu-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) mu-almost everywhere. D.closure is the genuine single-valued operator from that same graph closure, with its actual submodule domain.
Then for every u in this SAME D.closure.domain, if D.closure(u)=0 as an actual vector L2(mu) class, there exists a real c with (u as a scalar L2(mu) representative)(x)=c for mu-almost every x.
D is fixed before every u. The constant c is selected after u and may depend on u; no universal common constant for all zero-output elements is claimed. The premise is equality of the true closed-gradient output to the zero vector quotient, not a claim that the rough representative's totalized derivative vanishes pointwise. C1 regularity of W suffices here and no curvature, positive spectral gap, dense-domain condition or mean-zero assumption is added. This is a universal implication for a supplied closable exact-gradient D, not an existential construction of D. It is one direction only: zero output implies weighted-AE constancy. It does not produce constant-function domain membership or prove full kernel equality, nor a centered/epsilon-zero/range/Poincare or further inequality/core/composition theorem. There is no joint measurable choice of constants.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.WeakGradientZero
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedGradientDistribution

/-! Actual SAME original Gibbs closed-gradient zero implies AE constant; W C1 and true exponential integrability suffice. This one-way implication neither puts constants into the domain nor identifies the full kernel, Poincare or paper result. Includes dimension0. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter ContinuousLinearMap
open scoped Topology Convolution ContDiff
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GibbsGradientKernel
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

theorem closed_gradient_zero_ae_constant (W : E → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W)
    (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x))) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
    ∀ (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ), D.IsClosable →
      (∀ (a : Lp ℝ 2 μ) (H : Lp E 2 μ), (a,H) ∈ D.graph ↔
        ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
          a =ᵐ[μ] φ ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] gradient φ) →
      ∀ u : D.closure.domain, D.closure u = 0 →
        ∃ c : ℝ, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) =ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => c) := by
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
  dsimp only
  intro D hD hgraph u hz
  obtain ⟨hu,hG,hweak⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedGradientDistribution.closed_gradient_distributional
      W hW hI D hD hgraph (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) (D.closure u) (D.closure.mem_graph u)
  have hzero : (fun x => D.closure u x) =ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => (0:E)) := by
    rw [hz]
    exact Lp.coeFn_zero E 2 μ
  have hvol : (fun x => D.closure u x) =ᵐ[volume] (fun _ => (0:E)) :=
    (absolutelyContinuous_tilted hI).ae_eq hzero
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.WeakGradientZero.ordinary_weak_zero_gradient_ae_constant (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) hu (by
    intro ψ hψ hψc a
    obtain ⟨hi,hj,he⟩ := hweak ψ hψ hψc a
    refine ⟨hj,?_⟩
    have he0 : (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) a) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = ∫ x : E, (0:ℝ) := integral_congr_ae (by
          filter_upwards [hvol] with x hx
          simp [hx])
        _ = 0 := by simp
    rw [he0] at he
    linarith)
  exact ⟨c,(tilted_absolutelyContinuous (volume : Measure E) (fun x => -W x)).ae_eq hc⟩

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GibbsGradientKernel
